Class BuyLocomotiveController

java.lang.Object
controller.BuyLocomotiveController
public class BuyLocomotiveController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing locomotive purchases and availability Handles the creation, listing, and purchase of locomotives based on game scenarios

    • createLocomotive

      public void createLocomotive(String modelName, int price, String type, int fuelCost, int maintenanceCost, int startYearOfOperation, int endYearOfOperation, int topSpeed)
      Creates a new locomotive in the system
      Parameters:
      modelName - The model name of the locomotive
      price - The purchase price of the locomotive
      type - The type of locomotive (e.g., steam, diesel, electric)
      fuelCost - The fuel cost per operation
      maintenanceCost - The maintenance cost
      startYearOfOperation - The first year this locomotive is available
      endYearOfOperation - The last year this locomotive is available
      topSpeed - The maximum speed of the locomotive
